statement: A measurement-only (commit:) changeRef whose committed tree-to-tree range bundles the recording quest's OWN solve/ bookkeeping (solve/changes|log|quests|oracle|report|state|FRONTIER.generated.md for that quest id) alongside its source paths is no longer scope-refused in a runtime/product quest: inspectCommitChangeArtifact excludes the quest's own bookkeeping paths from the workflow-scope classification, mirroring what the Solver's own checkpoint commits legitimately bundle. Foreign workflow paths (scripts/solve/, another quest's solve/ tree, package.json, docs/steering/) in the range are STILL refused. This unblocks discharging a base-unreachable rejected-attempt replacement obligation when the reviewed source content is already committed in a checkpoint that bundled the quest's own bookkeeping (the oci-container-driver-live-activation impasse). Red-first test in test/solve/commit-changeref.test.js proves own-quest solve/ paths are excluded and foreign workflow paths still refuse; the change is subagent-verified.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
